rows.english: The UpForex website identifies UP Global Markets Ltd as licensed by the Financial Services Commission of Mauritius. It also identifies its UAE-affiliated partner as licensed under a Category 5 Arrangement and Advice licence. Traders can learn more about UpForex and explore the UpForex trading education blog for additional educational material.
rows.translation: UpForex 網站註明，UP Global Markets Ltd 獲得了毛里求斯金融服務委員會的許可。網站還註明，其阿聯酋關聯合作夥伴持有第 5 類安排與諮詢許可證。交易者可以瞭解更多 關於 UpForex的資訊，並瀏覽 UpForex 交易教育部落格以取得更多教育資料。

rows.english: If you hold other assets, equities, forex positions, or a broader investment portfolio, gold CFDs can serve as a hedge against downside risk. When equity markets fall or the dollar weakens, gold tends to rise, offsetting losses elsewhere. This is a more advanced use of gold CFDs that complements a wider trading or investment strategy. You can read more about this in our guide on how to invest in gold in UAE.
rows.translation: 如果您持有其他資產、股票、外匯部位或更廣泛的投資組合，黃金差價合約可以作為下行風險的避險工具。當股市下跌或美元走弱時，黃金往往會上漲，從而抵銷其他方面的損失。這是黃金差價合約的一種更進階用法，可以補充更廣泛的交易或投資策略。您可以閱讀我們的 如何在阿聯酋投資黃金指南，瞭解更多相關資訊。
